notes.title: Sorry for the inconvenience caused by the PlayTest qualification emails.
notes.content:
[p]First of all, we’re sorry for the PlayTest qualification emails bothering everyone.
We wanted to clear out the players who applied for the PlayTest last year in order to start a new round of player recruitment. However, since Steam doesn’t provide a “clear” button, we had no choice but to approve all the previous PlayTest applicants.[/p]
